## Legend

- **Storage** — `cell`: a row in `cells`; `item`: on the item row itself; `computed`: produced on read or by the worker. **Engine**: the value comes from its own endpoints or an engine rather than a plain cell write.
- **Settings** — `columns.settings`, from the type’s zod `settingsSchema` (JSON Schema, input side). _Default_ is what a new column gets (`defaultSettings`, else the schema default); _Required_ means the key must be sent when settings are sent. _Notes_ are the field’s source comment.
- **Value** — `cells.value` (`PUT /items/{id}/cells/{column}` body `{"value": …}`), from `valueSchema`; the example is generated and validated against the schema. _Derived columns_ are the denormalised text / number / date the server keeps for search, sort and summaries.
- **Filters** — the operators views, dashboards, `items/query` and automation conditions accept; the _model_ is how the query engine reads the value.
- **Automations** — triggers whose `column` may be this type; `column_changed` / `subitem_column_changed` hear any non-computed column; actions whose `column` may be this type (generic cell actions need a writable `cell` column).
- **API / MCP** — REST paths are under `/api/v1`; the MCP tools `create_column`, `update_column`, `update_item` take the same JSON.

## name — Name / שם

**Family:** Essentials · **Storage:** `item` · **Read-only through the API:** no · **Priority:** P0 · **Spec:** [03-COLUMN-TYPES.md §2.1](03-COLUMN-TYPES.md)

The item name; stored on `items.name`, never in cells.

### Settings

| Field         | Type                                                                           | Default | Required | Notes |
| ------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------ | ------- | -------- | ----- |
| `name_source` | object{mode, column_id, template, empty_text, warn_duplicates, open_on_create} | —       | no       |       |

Unknown keys are kept as sent.

New column defaults: `{}`

### Value

Shape: string (1–255 chars). `null` clears the cell.

```json
"example"
```

Derived columns for search, sort and summaries: text. In a formula `{column}` is its text.

### Filters

Model `text`; operators: `any_of`, `not_any_of`, `contains_text`, `not_contains_text`.

### Sort / Summary

Sort: by `text`. Summaries (group footer / dashboards): none.

### Automations

- Triggers: `column_changed`, `subitem_column_changed`
- Conditions: yes — the filter operators above
- Actions: `set_item_name`
- Fixed values typed as text (automations, paste, bulk edit, MCP plain values): no

### Import

- Values from text (CSV / sheet import, paste): no

### API

Every board has exactly one name column; it cannot be created.

Write (`PATCH /items/{item_id}`):

```json
{
  "name": "Item name"
}
```

### MCP

`update_item` `{item_id, cells: {"<column_id>": <value>}}` writes the value above.

## numbers — Numbers / מספרים

**Family:** Essentials · **Storage:** `cell` · **Read-only through the API:** no · **Priority:** P0 · **Spec:** [03-COLUMN-TYPES.md §2.4](03-COLUMN-TYPES.md)

Value is a JSON number; numeric strings from the API are coerced.

### Settings

## status — Status / סטטוס

**Family:** Essentials · **Storage:** `cell` · **Read-only through the API:** no · **Priority:** P0 · **Spec:** [03-COLUMN-TYPES.md §2.5](03-COLUMN-TYPES.md)

Value `{index}` is the stable label id; label colours are palette keys (imports map hex to the nearest).

### Settings

| Field                   | Type                                                                                  | Default                                                                                                                                                                         | Required | Notes                                                                                             |
| ----------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | -------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `labels`                | array<object{id, label, color, index, is_done, is_deactivated, description}> (max 40) | `[{"id":0,"label":"בתהליך","color":"yellow","index":0},{"id":1,"label":"הושלם","color":"forest","index":1,"is_done":true},{"id":2,"label":"חסום","color":"crimson","index":2}]` | yes      | Present when the source column is a label column: the labels in the order first met, with counts. |
| `post_update_on_change` | boolean                                                                               | —                                                                                                                                                                               | no       |                                                                                                   |
| `workflow`              | object{enabled, transitions, free_start, allow_clear, allow_override, automations}    | —                                                                                                                                                                               | no       | the optional workflow (allowed moves between labels).                                             |

Unknown keys are dropped.

New column defaults: `{"labels":[{"id":0,"label":"בתהליך","color":"yellow","index":0},{"id":1,"label":"הושלם","color":"forest","index":1,"is_done":true},{"id":2,"label":"חסום","color":"crimson","index":2}]}`

Shape: object{index}. `null` clears the cell.
Value-level checks against the settings apply (`validate`).

```json
}
```

| `hebrew_date`       | enum: "account" \| "on" \| "off"              | —       | no       | The Hebrew date in the cell: unset / 'account' = the account's setting.                       |
| `day_marks`         | enum: "account" \| "on" \| "off"              | —       | no       | Dots for days off / half days in the picker: unset / 'account' = the account's setting.       |

## phone — Phone / טלפון

**Family:** Essentials · **Storage:** `cell` · **Read-only through the API:** no · **Priority:** P0 · **Spec:** [03-COLUMN-TYPES.md §2.11](03-COLUMN-TYPES.md)

The number as typed is the display text; `e164` / `valid` are derived with libphonenumber from the cell's country, else the column's `default_country`, else the account's `locale.country` (columns/phone.ts).

### Settings

| Field                      | Type                                                                       | Default                                       | Required | Notes                                                                                               |
| -------------------------- | -------------------------------------------------------------------------- | --------------------------------------------- | -------- | --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `default_country`          | string                                                                     | `"IL"`                                        | no       | ISO country of numbers typed without a country code (e.g. 050…).                                    |
| `click_actions_enabled`    | boolean                                                                    | `true`                                        | no       | The on/off switch of the whole click menu (off = the number is plain text). Default on.             |
| `actions`                  | array<enum: "whatsapp" \| "telegram" \| "call" \| "sms" \| "copy"> (max 5) | `["whatsapp","telegram","call","sms","copy"]` | no       | Which actions the menu offers, in this order. Default: all of PHONE_ACTIONS.                        |
| `default_action`           | enum: "whatsapp" \| "telegram" \| "call" \| "sms" \| "copy"                | `"whatsapp"`                                  | no       | What a long press / Ctrl+click (or a user whose preference is "the column's default") does at once. |
| `telegram_username_column` | string (pattern `^[a-z][a-z0-9_]{0,19}$`) \| null                          | —                                             | no       | A text column of the same board with the person's Telegram username (t.me/<username> always works). |

Unknown keys are dropped.

New column defaults: `{"default_country":"IL","click_actions_enabled":true,"actions":["whatsapp","telegram","call","sms","copy"],"default_action":"whatsapp"}`

### Value

Shape: object{phone, country, e164, valid}. `null` clears the cell.
Optional keys: `country`, `e164`, `valid`.
Derived on every write (whatever is sent for them is replaced): `e164`, `valid` — recomputed when settings `default_country` change.

```json
{
  "phone": "050-123-4567",
  "country": "IL",
  "e164": "+972501234567",
  "valid": true
}
```

Derived columns for search, sort and summaries: text. In a formula `{column}` is its text.

```json
}
```

Derived columns for search, sort and summaries: text. In a formula `{column}` is its text.

### Filters

Model `text`; operators: `is_empty`, `is_not_empty`, `contains_text`.

### Sort / Summary

Sort: by `text`. Summaries (group footer / dashboards): `count`.

### Automations

- Triggers: `column_changed`, `subitem_column_changed`
- Conditions: yes — the filter operators above
- Actions: none — the cell is written only by its own endpoints, so generic cell actions do not apply
- Fixed values typed as text (automations, paste, bulk edit, MCP plain values): no

### Import

- Values from text (CSV / sheet import, paste): no

### API

Create (`POST /boards/{board_id}/columns`):

```json
{
  "title": "Doc",
  "type": "doc",

}
```

Write: `POST /items/{item_id}/cells/{column_id}/doc` (makes the doc in the cell):

```json
{
```

<a id="progress"></a>

## progress — Progress tracking / מעקב התקדמות

**Family:** Computed · **Storage:** `computed` (engine `progress`: computed on read from status columns / subitems) · **Read-only through the API:** yes · **Priority:** P1 · **Spec:** [03-COLUMN-TYPES.md §3.4](03-COLUMN-TYPES.md)

Computed on read from status columns (and optionally the subitems)

### Settings

| Field          | Type                                                                        | Default      | Required | Notes                                                                                                                                                       |
| -------------- | --------------------------------------------------------------------------- | ------------ | -------- | ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `source`       | enum: "subitems" \| "columns" \| "both"                                     | `"subitems"` | no       | The source. Absent (columns made before r15cols): the old rule — the chosen columns (none = every status column, equal weights) plus the subitems when set. |
| `columns`      | array<object{column_id, weight, done_labels}> (max 40)                      | `[]`         | no       | Status columns of the board and their weight; `done_labels` empty = the labels marked "done".                                                               |
| `subitems`     | object{column_id, weight, done_labels, recursive, weight_column_id} \| null | `null`       | no       | A status column of the subitems: the share of subitems on a "done" label counts with this weight.                                                           |
| `hide_percent` | boolean                                                                     | `false`      | no       | Hide the "68%" text next to the bar.                                                                                                                        |

Unknown keys are dropped.

New column defaults: `{"source":"subitems","columns":[],"subitems":null,"hide_percent":false}`

### Value

Shape: object{percent}.

```json
{
  "percent": 68
}
```

Derived columns for search, sort and summaries: text, number. In a formula `{column}` is its own value (number / text / boolean / {start, end}).

### Filters

Model `number`; operators: `any_of`, `not_any_of`, `greater_than`, `greater_than_or_equal`, `lower_than`, `lower_than_or_equal`, `between`, `is_empty`, `is_not_empty`.

### Sort / Summary

Sort: by `number`. Summaries (group footer / dashboards): `avg`, `min`, `max`, `median` — shown in the column’s own number format.

### Automations

- Triggers: none
- Conditions: yes — the filter operators above
- Actions: none
- Fixed values typed as text (automations, paste, bulk edit, MCP plain values): no

### Import

- Values from text (CSV / sheet import, paste): no

### API

Create (`POST /boards/{board_id}/columns`):

```json
{
  "title": "Progress tracking",
  "type": "progress",
  "settings": {
    "source": "subitems",
    "columns": [],
    "subitems": null,
    "hide_percent": false
  }
}
```

Read-only: computed by the server; change its settings with `PATCH /boards/{board_id}/columns/{column_id}`.

### MCP

`create_column` `{board_id, title, type, settings}` and `update_column` `{board_id, column_id, settings}` take the same JSON as the API above; cells are computed — nothing to write.

**Family:** Super useful · **Storage:** `cell` · **Read-only through the API:** no · **Priority:** P1 · **Spec:** [03-COLUMN-TYPES.md §3.10](03-COLUMN-TYPES.md)

<a id="ai"></a>

## ai — AI / AI

**Family:** Super useful · **Storage:** `cell` · **Read-only through the API:** no · **Priority:** P1 · **Spec:** [03-COLUMN-TYPES.md §3.13](03-COLUMN-TYPES.md)

AI column (the planning notes "AGENTS-MCP" מ11, D26). A cell the model fills from other columns of the item (and optionally its updates): summarise, classify into labels, extract one field, translate, or a custom prompt that names columns as `{Column title}` / `{column_id}`. Everything is the column's settings, chosen in the UI: the AI connection + model, the inputs, the instructions, limits, auto-run. Nothing per client in code.

### Settings

| Field                  | Type                                                                    | Default       | Required | Notes                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                               |
| ---------------------- | ----------------------------------------------------------------------- | ------------- | -------- | --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `kind`                 | enum: "summarize" \| "classify" \| "extract" \| "translate" \| "custom" | `"summarize"` | no       |                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                     |
| `connection_id`        | string (max 26) \| null                                                 | `null`        | no       | The AI connection (Administration → AI ו-MCP) and model; null = the column is not set up yet.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                       |
| `model`                | string (max 80) \| null                                                 | `null`        | no       |                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                     |
| `inputs`               | array<string (1–64 chars)> (max 30)                                     | `[]`          | no       | Input column ids (keys) of the same board; `{…}` references in `instructions` are added to them.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    |
| `include_name`         | boolean                                                                 | `true`        | no       |                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                     |
| `include_updates`      | boolean                                                                 | `false`       | no       | The item's latest updates as input (only what the person running it may read).                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      |
| `updates_limit`        | number (int, 1–20)                                                      | `5`           | no       |                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                     |
| `instructions`         | string (max 4000)                                                       | `""`          | no       | Custom prompt (kind custom) or extra instructions for the other kinds; `{Column}` references allowed.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                               |
| `length`               | enum: "short" \| "medium" \| "long"                                     | `"short"`     | no       | summarize                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                           |
| `labels_from`          | string (max 64) \| null                                                 | `null`        | no       | classify: the labels of a status / dropdown column of the board, or a fixed list.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                   |
| `labels`               | array<string (1–80 chars)> (max 50)                                     | `[]`          | no       | Present when the source column is a label column: the labels in the order first met, with counts.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                   |
| `write_to`             | string (max 64) \| null                                                 | `null`        | no       | classify: also write the label into this status / dropdown column (in the same undoable batch).                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                     |
| `extract`              | enum: "text" \| "number" \| "date" \| "email" \| "phone"                | `"text"`      | no       | extract                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                             |
| `language`             | string (max 40)                                                         | `"English"`   | no       | translate: target language, as a person writes it ("English", "עברית").                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                             |
| `output`               | enum: "text" \| "image"                                                 | `"text"`      | no       |                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                     |
| `image_column`         | string (max 64) \| null                                                 | `null`        | no       | output image: the file column (key) of the board the image is saved in.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                             |
| `image_size`           | string (pattern `^(auto\|\d{2,5}x\d{2,5})$`) \| null                    | `null`        | no       | output image: size / quality (null = the account's AI image defaults).                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              |
| `image_quality`        | string (pattern `^[a-z]{1,16}$`) \| null                                | `null`        | no       |                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                     |
| `source_image_columns` | array<string (1–64 chars)> (max 10)                                     | `[]`          | no       | Photos as input: file columns (keys) of the board, in order, whose images of the item go with the call in that order — image output starts from them (image to image), text output reads them (a model that sees images). Several columns: the prompt gets a line saying which pictures came from which column. Empty = text only, as before. (Read from the old single `source_image_column` too.) |
| `source_image_count`   | const "all" \| number (int, 1–20)                                       | `"all"`       | no       | How many images of each source column: `'all'` (default), or the newest N.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          |
| `when_no_source_image` | enum: "text" \| "skip"                                                  | `"text"`      | no       | An item without a photo there (see `AI_NO_SOURCE_IMAGE_MODES`): from the description only, or not run.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              |
| `style_examples`       | object{column, filter, count} \| null                                   | `null`        | no       | Style examples from other items (see `aiStyleExamplesSchema`); null = off (the default).                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            |
| `image_on_rerun`       | enum: "version" \| "add"                                                | `"version"`   | no       | output image: what a re-run does with the designs this cell made before (see `AI_IMAGE_RERUN_MODES`).                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                               |
| `photo_mode`           | enum: "each" \| "together"                                              | `"each"`      | no       | output image, several photos: one design per photo or one from all (see `AI_PHOTO_MODES`).                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          |
| `variations`           | number (int, 1–4)                                                       | `1`           | no       | output image: designs per call (1–4); each is its own charged image.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                |
| `fidelity`             | enum: "free" \| "close" \| "locked"                                     | `"free"`      | no       | output image: how much may change (see `AI_FIDELITY_MODES`).                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        |
| `fidelity_base_column` | string (max 64) \| null                                                 | `null`        | no       | `locked`: a file column (key) of the item holding the approved base design; null = the newest style example.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        |
| `auto_run`             | boolean                                                                 | `false`       | no       | Run by itself when one of its inputs changes, or a person adds a file to the source column (debounced, budget-checked).                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                             |
| `max_items_per_run`    | number (int, 1–1000)                                                    | `100`         | no       | Per-run limits: items one run fills, and dollars one run may spend.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                 |
| `max_usd_per_run`      | number (0.01–1000)                                                      | `1`           | no       |                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                     |
| `max_usd_per_month`    | number (0.01–100000) \| null                                            | `null`        | no       | Per-column limit: dollars a month (null = only the account budget).                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                 |

Unknown keys are dropped.

New column defaults: `{"kind":"summarize","connection_id":null,"model":null,"inputs":[],"include_name":true,"include_updates":false,"updates_limit":5,"instructions":"","length":"short","labels_from":null,"labels":[],"write_to":null,"extract":"text","language":"English","output":"text","image_column":null,"image_size":null,"image_quality":null,"source_image_columns":[],"source_image_count":"all","when_no_source_image":"text","style_examples":null,"image_on_rerun":"version","photo_mode":"each","variations":1,"fidelity":"free","fidelity_base_column":null,"auto_run":false,"max_items_per_run":100,"max_usd_per_run":1,"max_usd_per_month":null}`

### Value

Shape: object{text, number, date, ai, file_id}. `null` clears the cell.
Optional keys: `number`, `date`, `ai`, `file_id`.

```json
{

  "ai": {

    "cost_usd": 0.002,
    "kind": "summarize",
    "output": "text",
    "source_images": {
      "sent": 0,
      "total": 0,
      "examples": 0
    },
    "outputs": [
      {
        "file_id": "01ARZ3NDEKTSV4RRFFQ69G5FAV",
        "name": "Dana Levi",
        "source_asset_id": "01ARZ3NDEKTSV4RRFFQ69G5FAV",
        "variation": 1,
        "version": 1,
        "rejected": true,
        "source_images": {
          "sent": 0,
          "total": 0,
          "examples": 0
        },
        "status": "pending",
        "error": "example",
        "attempts": 0,
        "retry_at": "2026-03-01T09:00:00.000Z"
      }
    ],
    "calls": 0,
    "note": "example",
    "run_id": "01ARZ3NDEKTSV4RRFFQ69G5FAV"
  },
  "file_id": "01ARZ3NDEKTSV4RRFFQ69G5FAV"

```

Derived columns for search, sort and summaries: text, number, date. In a formula `{column}` is its text.

### Filters

Model `text`; operators: `any_of`, `not_any_of`, `is_empty`, `is_not_empty`, `contains_text`, `not_contains_text`, `starts_with`, `ends_with`.

### Sort / Summary

Sort: by `text`. Summaries (group footer / dashboards): `count`.

### Automations

- Triggers: `column_changed`, `subitem_column_changed`
- Conditions: yes — the filter operators above
- Actions: `set_column`, `clear_column`, `copy_from_linked`, `set_parent_column`, `set_subitems_column`, `copy_from_parent`, `copy_to_parent`, `copy_to_subitems`
- Fixed values typed as text (automations, paste, bulk edit, MCP plain values): yes (`fromText`)

### Import

- Values from text (CSV / sheet import, paste): yes (`fromText`)

### API

Create (`POST /boards/{board_id}/columns`):

```json
{
  "title": "AI",
  "type": "ai",
  "settings": {
    "kind": "summarize",
    "connection_id": null,
    "model": null,
    "inputs": [],
    "include_name": true,
    "include_updates": false,
    "updates_limit": 5,
    "instructions": "",
    "length": "short",
    "labels_from": null,
    "labels": [],
    "write_to": null,
    "extract": "text",
    "language": "English",
    "output": "text",
    "image_column": null,
    "image_size": null,
    "image_quality": null,
    "source_image_columns": [],
    "source_image_count": "all",
    "when_no_source_image": "text",
    "style_examples": null,
    "image_on_rerun": "version",
    "photo_mode": "each",
    "variations": 1,
    "fidelity": "free",
    "fidelity_base_column": null,
    "auto_run": false,
    "max_items_per_run": 100,
    "max_usd_per_run": 1,
    "max_usd_per_month": null
  }
}
```

Write a cell (`PUT /items/{item_id}/cells/{column_id}`; several at once: `PATCH /items/{item_id}` with `cells`; as text: `values`):

```json
{
  "value": {
    "text": "Example text",
    "number": 12.5,
    "date": "2026-03-01",
    "ai": {
      "at": "2026-03-01T09:00:00.000Z",
      "model": "gpt-4o-mini",
      "cost_usd": 0.002,
      "kind": "summarize",
      "output": "text",
      "source_images": {
        "sent": 0,
        "total": 0,
        "examples": 0
      },
      "outputs": [
        {
          "file_id": "01ARZ3NDEKTSV4RRFFQ69G5FAV",
          "name": "Dana Levi",
          "source_asset_id": "01ARZ3NDEKTSV4RRFFQ69G5FAV",
          "variation": 1,
          "version": 1,
          "rejected": true,
          "source_images": {
            "sent": 0,
            "total": 0,
            "examples": 0
          },
          "status": "pending",
          "error": "example",
          "attempts": 0,
          "retry_at": "2026-03-01T09:00:00.000Z"
        }
      ],
      "calls": 0,
      "note": "example",
      "run_id": "01ARZ3NDEKTSV4RRFFQ69G5FAV"
    },
    "file_id": "01ARZ3NDEKTSV4RRFFQ69G5FAV"
  }
}
```

### MCP

`create_column` `{board_id, title, type, settings}` and `update_column` `{board_id, column_id, settings}` take the same JSON as the API above; `update_item` `{item_id, cells: {"<column_id>": <value>}}` writes the value above or its plain text.

<a id="secret"></a>

## secret — Secret / סוד

**Family:** Advanced · **Storage:** `cell` (engine `secret`: the value is encrypted outside `cells` (secret endpoints); the cell is only a marker) · **Read-only through the API:** no · **Priority:** P2

Secret column (option 2): a password or key kept on an item, e.g. a client's site login.

### Settings

| Field                  | Type                                 | Default           | Required | Notes                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    |
| ---------------------- | ------------------------------------ | ----------------- | -------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ |
| `reveal_mode`          | enum: "board_members" \| "people"    | `"board_members"` | no       | Who may reveal: everyone who can see the column (and has 2FA), or only the listed people (with 2FA).                                                                                                                                                                                                                     |
| `reveal_user_ids`      | array<string (1–26 chars)> (max 500) | `[]`              | no       |                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          |
| `reveal_seconds`       | number (int, 5–300)                  | `30`              | no       | How long a revealed value stays on screen.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                               |
| `verify_minutes`       | number (int, 1–720)                  | `15`              | no       | How long a fresh two-factor code counts for revealing this column's values.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              |
| `copy_allowed`         | boolean                              | `true`            | no       |                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          |
| `change_requires_code` | boolean                              | `true`            | no       | Replacing or clearing an existing value needs the same fresh two-factor code as a reveal (within `verify_minutes`), besides edit rights. Setting a value into an empty cell does not — except in a check box, where an empty cell is "not checked" and checking it is a change (`secretChangeNeedsCode`). On by default. |
| `multiline`            | boolean                              | `false`           | no       | a long value of several lines (a key file, notes with a login) instead of one line — the editor is a text area and a revealed value shows whole. Off by default (one line, as before).                                                                                                                                   |
| `kind`                 | enum: "text" \| "checkbox"           | `"text"`          | no       | a check box (checked / not) kept like any secret — encrypted, revealed with a fresh code. The kind of a column that holds values does not change (the values would not fit).                                                                                                                                             |
| `checkbox_visible`     | boolean                              | `false`           | no       | A check box column only: whether it is checked shows to everyone who sees the column, without a code (changing it still follows `change_requires_code`). Off by default — hidden like any secret.                                                                                                                        |
| `alert_threshold`      | number (int, 0–1000)                 | `10`              | no       |                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          |

Unknown keys are kept as sent.

New column defaults: `{"reveal_mode":"board_members","reveal_user_ids":[],"reveal_seconds":30,"verify_minutes":15,"copy_allowed":true,"change_requires_code":true,"multiline":false,"kind":"text","checkbox_visible":false,"alert_threshold":10}`

### Value

Shape: object{set, updated_at, updated_by, checked}.
Optional keys: `checked`.

```json
{
  "set": true,
  "updated_at": "2026-03-01T09:00:00.000Z",
  "updated_by": "01ARZ3NDEKTSV4RRFFQ69G5FAV",
  "checked": true
}
```

Derived columns for search, sort and summaries: text, number. In a formula `{column}` is its own value (number / text / boolean / {start, end}).

### Filters

Model `number`; operators: `is_empty`, `is_not_empty`.

### Sort / Summary

Sort: not sortable. Summaries (group footer / dashboards): `count`.

### Automations

- Triggers: `column_changed`, `subitem_column_changed`
- Conditions: yes — the filter operators above
- Actions: none — the cell is written only by its own endpoints, so generic cell actions do not apply
- Fixed values typed as text (automations, paste, bulk edit, MCP plain values): no

### Import

- Values from text (CSV / sheet import, paste): no

### API

Create (`POST /boards/{board_id}/columns`):

```json
{
  "title": "Secret",
  "type": "secret",
  "settings": {
    "reveal_mode": "board_members",
    "reveal_user_ids": [],
    "reveal_seconds": 30,
    "verify_minutes": 15,
    "copy_allowed": true,
    "change_requires_code": true,
    "multiline": false,
    "kind": "text",
    "checkbox_visible": false,
    "alert_threshold": 10
  }
}
```

Write: `PUT /items/{item_id}/cells/{column_id}/secret` (a fresh 2FA code when the column requires one); reveal: `POST …/secret/reveal` `{"code"}`:

```json
{
  "value": "s3cret"
}
```

`PUT /cells` refuses this column; reads never return the value, only the marker.

### MCP

`create_column` `{board_id, title, type, settings}` and `update_column` `{board_id, column_id, settings}` take the same JSON as the API above; `update_item` cannot write this cell (its own endpoints do — see API).

<a id="signature"></a>

## signature — Signature / חתימה

**Family:** Advanced · **Storage:** `cell` (engine `signature`: written by the signing flow of an interactive document; evidence in `idoc_signatures`) · **Read-only through the API:** no · **Priority:** P2

Signature column: who signed an interactive document of the item, and when. Written only by the signing endpoint (engine 'signature' — PUT /cells refuses it, duplicate / board copy / templates skip it); the evidence (identity check, IP, what exactly was signed and its SHA-256, the consents) lives in `idoc_signatures` and opens as a certificate from the cell. Generic: quotes, agreements, field hand-over approvals, consent forms.

### Settings

| Field          | Type    | Default | Required | Notes                                                   |
| -------------- | ------- | ------- | -------- | ------------------------------------------------------- |
| `show_drawing` | boolean | `true`  | no       | Show the drawn signature in the cell when there is one. |

Unknown keys are kept as sent.

New column defaults: `{"show_drawing":true}`

### Value

Shape: object{signature_id, name, role, at, doc_id, version, has_drawing}.
Optional keys: `role`, `has_drawing`.

```json
{
  "signature_id": "01ARZ3NDEKTSV4RRFFQ69G5FAV",
  "name": "Dana Levi",
  "role": "CEO",
  "at": "2026-03-01T09:00:00.000Z",
  "doc_id": "01ARZ3NDEKTSV4RRFFQ69G5FAV",
  "version": 1,
  "has_drawing": true
}
```

Derived columns for search, sort and summaries: text, number, date. In a formula `{column}` is its own value (number / text / boolean / {start, end}).

### Filters

Model `date`; operators: `is_empty`, `is_not_empty`.

### Sort / Summary

Sort: by `date`. Summaries (group footer / dashboards): `count`.

### Automations

- Triggers: `column_changed`, `subitem_column_changed`
- Conditions: yes — the filter operators above
- Actions: none — the cell is written only by its own endpoints, so generic cell actions do not apply
- Fixed values typed as text (automations, paste, bulk edit, MCP plain values): no

### Import

- Values from text (CSV / sheet import, paste): no

### API

Create (`POST /boards/{board_id}/columns`):

```json
{
  "title": "Signature",
  "type": "signature",
  "settings": {
    "show_drawing": true
  }
}
```

Written only when a client signs an interactive document (`POST /public/idocs/{token}/sign`); the certificate is `GET /signatures/{signature_id}`. No direct write.

### MCP

`create_column` `{board_id, title, type, settings}` and `update_column` `{board_id, column_id, settings}` take the same JSON as the API above; `update_item` cannot write this cell (its own endpoints do — see API).
